journey.title: Dismiss suggestions with Escape while editing a saved city
journey.goal: Escape closes the suggestion list and keeps the city the user typed

functionalJourney.title: Pick a suggested city with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Typing part of a name and clicking a suggestion saves that city

guards.title: ArrowDown and Enter still select a suggestion
guards.goal: Typing Fa, ArrowDown and Enter saves Faro

plan.root_cause: Escape key handler clears input value, causing loss of typed text.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the Escape case in listController.js navigate function to retain the input value while closing the suggestion list.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close the suggestion list without altering the input value, preserving user input and focus.
functional_risks: Other components may rely on Escape clearing the input value; however the clear event is still emitted, allowing consumers to reset value if needed.
verification_requirements: Ensure Escape closes suggestions and retains input value.
Ensure focus returns to the input after Escape.
Ensure form data reflects the typed value after Escape.

attempts.failure: Edit 1 (src/controllers/listController.js): before does not occur in the file. 2 of its lines are not in the source. not in file: "// Clear \\\"input\\\" value"; closest is line 258: "// Clear \"input\" value" | not in file: "ctx.input.value = \\\"\\\";"; closest is line 259: "ctx.input.value = \"\";". Copy before verbatim from source_candidates.
